mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a felony and it is committed against lawfully constituted government of the State or the Federation of Nigeria."
Treason is a felony and it is committed against lawfully constituted government of the State or the Federation of Nigeria.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refer to a matter of fact either past or present."
The representation must refer to a matter of fact either past or present.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an intent to induce another by deceit, to act to his detriment or contrary to what would otherwise be his duty and it is immaterial that there is no intention to cause pecuniary or economic loss."

An intent to defraud is an intent to induce another by deceit, to act to his detriment or contrary to what would otherwise be his duty and it is immaterial that there is no intention to cause pecuniary or economic loss.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an offence which when committed, attracts punishment, as contained in the code."
Stealing is an offence which when committed, attracts punishment, as contained in the code.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the process of pronouncing a particular punishment on the accused person who has been found guilty by the trial court."
Sentencing is the process of pronouncing a particular punishment on the accused person who has been found guilty by the trial court.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means the killing of a person in a manner not justified by law."
Homicide means the killing of a person in a manner not justified by law.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a government agency whose sole responsibility is to enforce and maintain laws and orders."
The Nigeria Police Force is a government agency whose sole responsibility is to enforce and maintain laws and orders.
fib: ______ are those offences which were developed from the customs and tradition of the English people.
Common law offences
Common law offences are those offences which were developed from the customs and tradition of the English people.
______ means being in physical possession of property, while constructive possession means holding it through a servant or other agent(s).
Actual possession
Actual possession means being in physical possession of property, while constructive possession means holding it through a servant or other agent(s).
______ is the major determining factor in distinguishing between the offence of burglary and house breaking.
Time
Time is the major determining factor in distinguishing between the offence of burglary and house breaking.
______ is the act or omission done or omitted while the mental element is the intent to commit or omit the crime.
physical element
The physical element is the act or omission done or omitted while the mental element is the intent to commit or omit the crime.
______ means desire of consequence, and it could be derived from the circumstance of a particular case.
Intention
Intention means desire of consequence, and it could be derived from the circumstance of a particular case.
______ are those breaches of the law which the law forbids and also failing by way of missions to do, what the law has commanded.
Crimes
Crimes are those breaches of the law which the law forbids and also failing by way of missions to do, what the law has commanded.
______ is an authority issued by a court to a police officer to arrest an offender.
warrant of arrest
A warrant of arrest is an authority issued by a court to a police officer to arrest an offender.
